_comment: Maps a spreadsheet's file name to the link the dashboard opens. Only _folder is required: any file not listed here gets folder_url + / + its name, so a new client matrix needs no entry. web=1 is what makes SharePoint open the file in Excel for the web; without it a plain document path is served as a DOWNLOAD, which defeats the point of everyone editing one shared file. push_snapshot.py adds web=1 on its own, so entries here can be plain paths.
